description: Run a padded, level-synchronous Blelloch upsweep/downsweep exclusive integer scan.

output.encoding: N exclusive prefix sums; out[0]=0 and out[i]=sum(a[0..i))

workspace.meaning: At most 64 signed 64-bit padded tree entries (512 bytes), scalar loop state, and bounded language-container overhead; the caller's output buffer is accounted separately.

contract.padding: P is the least power of two >= N; entries N through P-1 are initialized to additive identity 0.
contract.upsweep: For stride 2,4,...,P and half=stride/2, update disjoint right endpoints r=stride-1,stride-1+stride,... with tree[r]+=tree[r-half]. Each level reads the previous complete level.
contract.downsweep: For stride P,P/2,...,2 and half=stride/2, for each right endpoint r save t=tree[r-half], set tree[r-half]=tree[r], then tree[r]+=t. Each level reads the previous complete level.
contract.result: Return tree[0..N] as exclusive prefix sums; the reduction total is not emitted.
contract.parallel_model: The native loops simulate a barrier between each tree level; updates within a level target disjoint endpoints.
contract.overflow_bound: Every partial sum covers a subset of at most 64 values in [-1000000,1000000], so all intermediates fit signed 64-bit and have magnitude at most 64000000.
contract.work_and_span: For padded size P, the tree performs 2(P-1) additions over 2*log2(P) barrier levels; P=1 performs no tree updates.
contract.error_precedence: Validate the full input frame before checking output nullness or capacity; malformed input returns -1, otherwise null or undersized output returns -2 without writes.

references.primary: primary_oracle.py: execute the upsweep, root reset, and downsweep by complete levels over a padded power-of-two tree.
references.independent: independent_oracle.py: calculate each exclusive result with a left-to-right running sum.
